questions.q: Application software is also known as what?
questions.e: Application software is also called end-user or productivity programs.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of application software?
o: To help users perform specific tasks
questions.e: Application software is designed for users to perform specific tasks.

questions.q: Why does each application software have a user interface?
o: So users can easily use it
questions.e: The user interface makes the software easy for users to operate.

questions.q: What is a bundle of application software called?
questions.e: Applications bundled together form an application suite.

questions.q: Which is the classic example of an application suite given in the lesson?
questions.e: Microsoft Office is the example of an application suite.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT application software?
questions.e: Windows is system software; the others are application software.

questions.q: Which tasks can application software perform?
o: Playing games, designing graphics, and watching videos
questions.e: Applications cover games, graphics, music, video, and many other tasks.

questions.q: What are word processors mainly used for?
o: Documentation, including storing, formatting, and printing documents
questions.e: Word processors create, store, format, and print documents.

questions.q: Which is a word processor developed by Apple?
questions.e: Apple Pages is a word processor.

questions.q: Google Docs is classified as what type of application?
questions.e: Google Docs is a cloud-based word processor.

questions.q: Database software is also known by what acronym?
questions.e: Database software is known as a Database Management System (DBMS).

questions.q: What is the main function of database software?
o: To create and manage a database and organize data
questions.e: DBMS software helps create, manage, and organize databases.

questions.q: Which is an example of database software?
questions.e: MySQL, MS Access, and dBase are database programs.

questions.q: Which group contains ONLY database software?
questions.e: Access, MySQL, and dBase are all database tools.

questions.q: What does multimedia software allow users to do?
o: Play, create, or record images, audio, or video
questions.e: Multimedia software handles images, audio, and video.

questions.q: Which is an example of multimedia software?
questions.e: VLC, iMovie, and Premiere Pro are multimedia programs.

questions.q: Adobe Premiere Pro is best classified as what?
questions.e: Premiere Pro is used for video editing, a multimedia task.

questions.q: Education and reference software is also called what?
questions.e: Education and reference software is termed academic software.

questions.q: What is the purpose of education and reference software?
o: To facilitate learning on a particular subject
questions.e: It is designed to help users learn a subject.

questions.q: Which is an example of education and reference software from the lesson?
questions.e: Microsoft Encarta, Canvas, and MindPlay are academic software examples.

questions.q: Graphics software is designed to do what?
o: Work with graphics and edit visual data or images
questions.e: Graphics software includes picture editors and illustration tools.

questions.q: Which is an example of graphics software?
questions.e: Photoshop, AutoCAD, and Blender are graphics software.

questions.q: Blender is classified as which type of application?
questions.e: Blender is a 3D graphics and animation tool.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of a web browser?
o: To browse the internet and locate and retrieve data across the web
questions.e: Browsers locate and retrieve data across the web.

questions.q: Which is an example of a web browser?
questions.e: Chrome, Internet Explorer, and Firefox are browsers.

questions.q: What do email programs do?
questions.e: Email programs handle sending and receiving messages.

questions.q: Which is an example of an email program?
questions.e: Outlook, Gmail, and Apple Mail are email programs.

questions.q: Communications software allows two computers with modems to communicate through what means?
questions.e: Communications software supports audio, video, and chat communication.

questions.q: Which is an example of communications software?
questions.e: LINE, Messenger, and Zoom are communications software.

questions.q: Spreadsheet software is especially useful for what kind of problems?
o: Number-intensive problems such as budgeting and forecasting
questions.e: Spreadsheets handle calculations, budgets, and forecasts.

questions.q: Which feature allows spreadsheet software to visualize data?
o: Plotting graphs based on provided data
questions.e: Spreadsheets can plot graphs from their data.

questions.q: Which is an example of spreadsheet software?
questions.e: Excel, Google Sheets, and Apple Numbers are spreadsheets.

questions.q: Presentation software creates what?
o: Multimedia stacks of cards or screens
questions.e: Presentations are stacks of screens advanced by clicking.

questions.q: Which is an example of presentation software?
questions.e: PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote are presentation tools.

questions.q: How does a user usually advance to the next screen in a presentation?
questions.e: Users click buttons to move through the slide sequence.

questions.q: Freeware is best described as what?
o: Completely free software that never requires payment as long as it is not modified
questions.e: Freeware is free to use as long as it is not modified.

questions.q: What distinguishes open source software from freeware?
o: The source code is also available to everyone
questions.e: Open source makes the source code available, not just the program.

questions.q: What is shareware or trial software?
o: Software that lets you try it for a few days before buying
questions.e: Shareware offers a trial period before purchase or registration.

questions.q: What happens after a shareware trial expires?
o: You are asked to enter a code or register the product
questions.e: After the trial, users must register or enter a code to continue.

questions.q: Adware earns revenue for its developer by doing what?
questions.e: Adware shows ads to generate revenue.

questions.q: Donationware asks the user to do what?
o: Pay an optional amount for the full-featured version
questions.e: Donationware requests an optional donation.

questions.q: Nagware constantly does what?
o: Reminds the user to pay through alert messages or dialogue boxes
questions.e: Nagware repeatedly prompts the user to pay.

questions.q: Which are other names for nagware?
questions.e: Nagware is also called begware, annoyware, or begscreen.

questions.q: How does freemium software work?
o: Basic features are free while premium features require payment
questions.e: Freemium offers free basics and paid premium features.

questions.q: What is demoware?
o: A trial or demonstration version of software
questions.e: Demoware provides a demo or trial version.

questions.q: Crippleware provides what during its trial?
o: Only a certain number of features, with a time limit
questions.e: Crippleware limits features and has a time limit.

questions.q: Trialware provides what during its trial period?
o: All the features of the software within a time limit
questions.e: Trialware gives full features for a limited period.

questions.q: Which type of software is free but does NOT provide source code?
questions.e: Freeware is free to use but does not include source code.

questions.q: A program is free, and its source code is available for anyone to study and modify. What is it?
questions.e: Open source software provides access to source code.

questions.q: Which type of shareware gives a full-featured version and asks for an optional payment?
questions.e: Donationware requests an optional contribution.

questions.q: Which type of shareware displays advertisements to earn revenue?
questions.e: Adware is advertising-supported software.

questions.q: Which type of shareware repeatedly displays bold messages asking the user to register?
questions.e: Nagware nags users with payment reminders.

questions.q: A game gives you only three levels and stops after 14 days unless you buy it. This is an example of what?
questions.e: Feature-limited, time-limited trials are crippleware.

questions.q: An editing app gives all its tools for 30 days, then locks completely. This is what?
questions.e: Full features for a limited time is trialware.

questions.q: A cloud service offers free storage but charges for extra features. This is what?
questions.e: Free basics with paid premium features is the freemium model.

questions.q: Which software category would a student use to write an essay?
questions.e: Essays are written with word processors.

questions.q: A small business wants to track expenses and create charts. Which application fits best?
questions.e: Spreadsheets handle budgeting, calculations, and graphs.

questions.q: A school needs to store student records and search them quickly. Which software is appropriate?
questions.e: A DBMS organizes and retrieves structured records.

questions.q: A marketing team needs to present a sales pitch with slides. Which software?
questions.e: Presentations create slide sequences for pitches and lessons.

questions.q: A designer needs to retouch a photo and remove a background. Which software?
questions.e: Graphics software edits and manipulates visual data.

questions.q: What is the general name for software designed for users to perform specific tasks?
questions.e: Application or end-user software performs specific tasks.

questions.q: What is a bundle of application software called?
questions.e: Bundled applications form an application suite.

questions.q: What do we call software used to create and manage a database?
questions.e: Database software is also called a DBMS.

questions.q: What type of software plays, creates, or records images, audio, or video?
questions.e: Multimedia software handles audio, video, and images.

questions.q: What is another term for education and reference software?
questions.e: Education and reference software is called academic software.

questions.q: What type of software lets users edit visual data such as images and illustrations?
questions.e: Graphics software includes picture editors and illustration tools.

questions.q: What application is used to browse the internet and retrieve data across the web?
questions.e: Web browsers locate and retrieve web content.

questions.q: What type of program is used to send and receive email?
questions.e: Email programs handle sending and receiving messages.

questions.q: What software allows two computers with modems to communicate through audio, video, or chat?
questions.e: Communications software enables real-time communication.

questions.q: What application is used for number-intensive tasks like budgeting and forecasting?
questions.e: Spreadsheets compute numerical problems and plot graphs.

questions.q: What application creates multimedia stacks of cards or screens for a lesson or pitch?
questions.e: Presentation software builds slide decks.

questions.e: Freeware is free to use but not to modify.

questions.e: Open source provides both the program and its source code.

questions.e: Shareware or trial software expires after a trial period.

questions.e: Adware is advertising-supported software.

questions.e: Donationware asks for an optional donation.

questions.q: What software model offers basic features for free and premium features for a fee?
questions.e: Freemium combines free basics with paid premium features.

questions.e: Crippleware limits features and time.

questions.q: What type of trial software provides all features within a time limit?
questions.e: Trialware gives full features for a limited period.

questions.q: What is the general category for trial or demonstration versions of software?
questions.e: Demoware is divided into crippleware and trialware.

questions.q: What is the Apple word processor called?
questions.e: Apple Pages is the company's word processor.

questions.q: What is Google's spreadsheet application called?
questions.e: Google Sheets is a cloud spreadsheet.

questions.q: What Adobe application is used for professional video editing?
questions.e: Adobe Premiere Pro is a multimedia video editor.

questions.q: What is the Microsoft database application called?
questions.e: MS Access is Microsoft's database software.
